name: First Shift
tagline: Open the parking lot: park arriving cars and release departing ones.
brief: Park incoming cars and authorize completed stays through the exit gate.
context: Arriving cars join the entrance queue, while departing cars request exit authorization.
narrative:
Welcome to ParkFlow Smart Facility Operations!

Your parking facility is opening its first shift. Arriving cars queue up at the entrance, while parked cars finish their stay and request to exit.

Controlling a facility requires managing both ends: release departing cars when an exit is requested so capacity is freed, and park arriving cars in available standard spaces.
objective: Serve every arriving car without an allocation violation.
learningObjective: Coordinate both entrances and exits: process exit requests first to free capacity for new arrivals.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starting brain has no rules. Add two rules:
1. WHEN hasExitRequest -> DO release-vehicle
2. WHEN hasWaitingVehicle -> DO park-standard

Order exit release above arrival parking so departing cars free up spots for incoming vehicles.
hint: Add WHEN hasExitRequest -> DO release-vehicle above WHEN hasWaitingVehicle -> DO park-standard.
hints: Check the exit queue first so completed stays release capacity.
Place WHEN hasExitRequest -> DO release-vehicle at the top.
Place WHEN hasWaitingVehicle -> DO park-standard second.

steps.label: Park an arriving car into a standard space

functions.description: Assign the head vehicle to a standard space.
